[image: Protecting Our Environment illustration] Protecting Our Environment Lydia is committed to protecting the Great Lakes which hold 20% of the world's surface freshwater. Securing vital federal funding for water infrastructure. She will preserve Michigan’s iconic landscapes Read More

[image: Protecting the Great Lakes and Upper Peninsula Waters from Mining Pollution illustration] Protecting the Great Lakes and Upper Peninsula Waters from Mining Pollution Mining operations threaten Michigan's watersheds and the Great Lakes. Lydia will oppose permits that allow mining discharge into waters that flow toward Lake Superior, push for federal enforcement of the Clean Water Act with real teeth, and put the burden of proof on the polluter instead of on fish and communities. Read More

[image: Restoring Tribal Sovereignty and Treaty Rights illustration] Restoring Tribal Sovereignty and Treaty Rights The federal government signed treaties with tribal nations. A president cannot unilaterally dissolve them or reduce co-managed lands by executive order. Lydia will restore violated co-management agreements, codify tribal consultation as mandatory with binding say, support tribal land acquisition and restoration with federal funding, protect treaty rights to water and harvesting, and oppose treating treaties as subject to revision by executive order.
